gloss: a mountain of; huge piles of; an enormous amount of

definitions.gloss: a mountain of; piled high; an enormous amount of
definitions.explanation: A simile likening a large quantity to a mountain. Used with concrete things stacked up ({書類|しょるい}, {洗濯物|せんたくもの}) and with abstract ones (work, complaints).

examples.japanese: {宿題|しゅくだい}が{山|やま}のようにある。
examples.english: I have a mountain of homework.

examples.japanese: {机|つくえ}の{上|うえ}に{書類|しょるい}が{山|やま}のように{積|つ}まれている。
examples.english: Documents are piled like a mountain on the desk.

examples.japanese: {連休|れんきゅう}{明|あ}けはメールが{山|やま}のように{届|とど}いていて、{処理|しょり}に{半日|はんにち}かかった。
examples.english: After the long weekend, a mountain of emails had arrived, and it took half a day to process them.

notes:
Modifier built from {山|やま} (mountain) + のよう (looking like). Used adverbially with に ({山|やま}のように) or as a noun modifier with な.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- With に: as an adverb modifying a verb ({山|やま}のようにある、{積|つ}まれている、{届|とど}く)
- With な: as a noun modifier ({山|やま}のような{量|りょう})

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕事|しごと}が{山|やま}のようにある: to have a mountain of work
- {山|やま}のような{書類|しょるい}: a mountain of paperwork
- {不満|ふまん}が{山|やま}のようにある: to have a mountain of complaints

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {山|やま}ほど: 'as much as a mountain' — interchangeable in most contexts, slightly more casual
- たくさん: a lot — neutral and lacks the vivid 'piled high' image
- {膨大|ぼうだい}な: enormous — more formal, used for abstract quantities like data
